title: Network Engineering
blurb: Switching, routing, VLANs, OSPF and BGP, network services and security, VPNs, zero trust, troubleshooting and automation.

quiz.question: How does a switch learn which port a device is on?
options: From the source MAC of incoming frames
quiz.explanation: It records source MAC → port in its MAC address table.

quiz.question: A router has routes 0.0.0.0/0 and 10.1.0.0/16. Which is used for 10.1.4.7?
quiz.explanation: The most specific matching prefix wins.

quiz.question: What does an 802.1Q trunk port do?
quiz.explanation: Trunks tag frames with VLAN IDs between switches and routers.

quiz.question: Which protocol prevents Layer 2 loops?
quiz.explanation: STP blocks redundant paths and unblocks them on failure.

quiz.question: OSPF is best described as…
quiz.explanation: Routers flood link states and compute shortest paths with Dijkstra.

quiz.question: Small requests work over a VPN but large transfers hang. Most likely cause?
quiz.explanation: Tunnel overhead plus blocked ICMP fragmentation-needed; fix with MSS clamping.

quiz.question: In a packet capture, repeated SYNs with no reply suggest…
options: Packets are being silently dropped (firewall, security group or return route)
quiz.explanation: A RST would mean reachable but refused; silence means drops.

quiz.question: How does ZTNA differ from a traditional remote-access VPN?
options: It grants per-application access after identity and device checks, not network-level access
quiz.explanation: Users never join the network, limiting lateral movement.

problems.title: Segment a flat network
problems.prompt: A hospital runs everything on one /16. Design segmentation.
problems.solution: Define zones (clinical devices, staff, servers, management, guests, DMZ), VLANs and subnets per zone, default-deny firewall policy with a documented allowed-flows table, medical devices restricted to their servers, 802.1X with quarantine VLAN, ZTNA for remote access, flow and DNS logs to SIEM with alerts on workstation-to-workstation SMB.

problems.title: Troubleshoot an unreachable app
problems.prompt: Users at one branch cannot reach an internal web app.
problems.solution: Scope and check changes, verify link/VLAN/IP/gateway, DNS, route there and back, TCP port reachability through firewalls, TLS and app health; confirm with tcpdump on both ends; fix and document.
